name: FFS_FILE_METADATA
description: Stores meta data of files uploaded to storage as file properties or as a part of submitted forms.

columns.name: FILE_ID
columns.description: Identity of the file in Object Storage. Primary Identifier.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file name.

columns.name: CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file content type.

columns.name: FILE_SIZE
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file size.

columns.name: THUMB_SIZE
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file thumbnail file size.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file decription.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file creation time.

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage last update time.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE
columns.description: Defines if the file is a part of a group.

columns.name: MASTER_FILE_ID
columns.description: One-to-many relation between files.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Current uploading status to storage.

columns.name: URI
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file uri.

columns.name: THUMB_URI
columns.description: Thumb file uri path or collage coordinates string, json.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: File external Id...............

columns.name: STORAGE
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file storage.

columns.name: COORD_X
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file Coord x.

columns.name: COORD_Y
columns.description: Stored in Object Storage file Coord y.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
